title: Keep swimming pools behind a child-resistant barrier
what: As the owner of premises with a regulated swimming pool, maintain an effective and safe child-resistant safety barrier for the pool (and, for pools built before 1 May 2013, lodge a compliance status certificate when required).

sources.title: Building Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 83N(1) (current republication (R57, from 10 November 2026; Building Act 2004 | Acts))
sources.quote: A person commits an offence if— (a) the person is the owner of premises on which a regulated swimming pool is located; and (b) the person fails to maintain a safety barrier for the pool that is an effective and safe child-resistant barrier

sources.title: Building Act 2004 (ACT)
sources.locator: s 83D(2), words naming the body (found 23 Nov 2026) (current republication (R57, from 10 November 2026; Building Act 2004 | Acts)
sources.quote: On application, the Minister may grant an exemption only if a circumstance prescribed by regulation applies to the regulated swimming pool.
